paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni khat in buhlei ah apaisuak a, anungzuite'n buhvuite akhiak ua, akhutpek ua nuaisiang in ane uhi.
heading: Sabbath Thu A Dotna / (Mat 12.1-8; Mar 2.23-28)
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

paite: Pharisai kuate hiam in, "Bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "David agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh huai bangte leng na sim kei ua hia?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

paite: Huchi a Pathian inn a lut a, siampute lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam alak a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu," achi hi.
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni dang khat in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh a; huai ah mi khat khut taklam zaw ana om hi.
heading: Pasal Khutzaw Hihdamna / (Mat 12.9-14; Mar 3.1-6)
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n ahekna ding amuhtheihna ding un, Sabbath ni in hihdam ding in akisa hia kisa lou asim et uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

paite: Himahleh ama'n alungsim uh thei a, khutzaw kiang ah, "Thou inla, alai ah dingkhia in," achi hi. Huan athou a, adingkheta hi.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hia, hihsiat? Hotdam asiang hia, hihlup? K'on dong ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

paite: Huan avek un a-en velvel a, akiang ah, "Na khut zankhia in,” achi hi. Huan azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

paite: Huchi in aheh lo mahmah ua, Jesu tung a hihdan ding akihouta uhi.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a kipan in apawt a, thum ding in tang ah akuan a, Pathian kiang ah zankhua in athum hi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nih Sehna / (Mat 10.1-4; Mar 3.13-19)
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

paite: Khua avaktak in anungzuite asam a; alak uah sawm-le-nih atel a, amin ding un leng Sawltakte asa hi.
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

paite: Huaite Simon Peter achih leh a-unaupa Andru, Jakob leh Johan, Philip leh Bartholomai,
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

paite: Matthai leh Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Zealot kichi Simon,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

paite: leh Jakob tapa Judas leh amansakpa Judas Iskariot ahi uh.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

paite: Huan amau toh apaikhia a, mun zang ah adingh a, anungzui mipite toh, Judia gam tengteng a kipan leh Jerusalem a kipan leh Tura leh Sidon kholam a tuipi gei a kipan mipi tampitak athu ngainuam leh adamlouhnate uh hihdam ut in ahong pai uhi.
heading: Jesu Sinsakna leh Hihdamna / (Mat 4.23-25)
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

paite: Huchi in dawi nin sukbuaite leng damsak in a-omta uhi.
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

paite: Huan akiang a kipan thilhihtheihna apawtkhia a, michih ahihdam zel ziak in mipi tengteng in amah khoih atum uhi.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

paite: Huan adakkhia a, anungzuite mitsuan kawm in agen a: "Nou gentheite aw, na hampha uh; Pathian lalgam nou a ahi ngal a.
heading: Hamphatna leh Tunggikna / (Mat 5.1-12)
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

paite: Nou tua gilkialte aw, na hampha uh, tai ding na hi ngal ua. Nou tua kapte aw, na hampha uh, nui ding na hi ngal ua."
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

paite: "Mihing Tapa ziak a mite'n ahon huat ua, hon pampaih ua, hon tai ua, na min uh ahoih kei chi a ahon paihmang chiang un, na hampha ding uh.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

paite: Huai ni in kipak unla, nuam in tawm un, ngai un, van ah na kipahman uh a-om kihkeih hi; huchibang mah in apipute un zawlneite tung ah ahih uhi.”
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

paite: "Himahleh, nou mihaute aw, na tung uh agik e; na khamuanna uh na mu khinta ngal ua;
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

paite: nou tua vahte aw, na tung uh agik e; na gil uh ahong kial ding. Nou tua nuite aw; na tung uh agik e; lungkham a kap ding na hi ngal ua."
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

paite: "Mi tengteng in ahon phat chiang un na tung uh agik ding hi; huchi mah bang in apipute un zawlnei takloute tung ah ahih uhi.
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

paite: "Ka thu ngaikhete aw, ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon hote hoihna ding hih un,
heading: Melmate Itna / (Mat 5.38-48; 7.12a)
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

paite: Hon hamsiatte vualzawl unla, hon simmohte thumsak un.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

paite: Biang langkhat a hon bengpa alehlam leng doh in; na puan hon laksakpa kiang ah na puanak leng it ke'n.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

paite: Ahon ngen peuh kiang ah pia in; huan na van hon laksakpa kiang ah ngen nawn ke'n.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

paite: Huan mi'n na tung ua ahih ding uh na deih bang zel un mi tung ah leng hih sam un.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

paite: "Huan ahon itte kia na it un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng amau itte a-it sam ve ua oi!
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

paite: Na tung ua hoihte tung kia a na hoih un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel ve ua oi.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

paite: Muh nawn lametnate kiang kia a thil na leitawisak un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng angeingei mu nawn ding in mikhialte kiang ah aleitawisak sam uhi.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

paite: Himahleh na melmate uh it unla, ahoihna ding un hih unla, lunglel het lou in leitawisak un; huchi in na kipahman uh atam dia, Tungnungpen tate na hi ding uh; ama'n mi kipahna dan theiloute leh migiloute ahehpih hi.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

paite: Na Pa azahngaih theih bang in zahngai thei in om un.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

paite: "Hawmsak kei un, huchi in hawmsak in na om kei ding uh; kuamah siam lou in sep kei un, huchi in siam louh in na om kei ding uh; ngaidam un, huchi in ngaihdam in na om ding uh;
heading: Midangte Dem Thu / (Mat 7.1-5)
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

paite: pia un, huchi in piak in na om ding uh, hoihtak a teh a, hen gak a, sin gak in, let nawinawi in na angsung uah piak in na om ding uh. Noumau tehna ngei mah a tehsak a piak in na om ding uh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, gentehna agen a: "Mittaw in mittaw mah api thei diam? Anih un kokhuk ah akekhawm kei ding ua hia?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

paite: Asinsakpa tung ah nungzui a-om kei; himahleh mi kuapeuh kisinsiamtate asinsakpa bang in a-om ding uh.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

paite: "Huan bangziak a na mit a singtum om limsak lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik om mu na hia?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

paite: Nangmah mit a singtum om mu lou in, na unau kiang a, 'Unau, na mit a ninneng neuchik om hon lakhesak ve,' bangchi a chi thei na hia? Milepchiah na mit a pan singtum lakhe masa in, huchi in na unau mit a ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding chiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

paite: "Sing hoih gahsia a gah a-om ngei kei; sing sia lah gah hoih a gah a-om ngei sam kei hi.
heading: Sing leh Agah / (Mat 7.16-20; 12.33-35)
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

paite: Sing chih amau gah chiat ah akithei hi. Mi'n khaulingnei kung ah theipi alou ngei kei uh, loubukh lingnok lak ah grep gah alou ngei sam kei uh.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

paite: Mihoih in alungtang goubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a; migilou in alungtang goubawm sia a kipan thil hoihloute alakhe zel hi; alungtang a dim val kam in agen zel ngal a.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

paite: "Huan nou bang ding a, ka gente hihloupi a, Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na hi ua?
heading: Inn Lamdan Nihte / (Mat 7.24-27)
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

paite: Michih ka kiang a hong a, ka thu za a zui peuhmah kua bang ahi ua, ka hon ensak ding:
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

paite: Amah zaw inn lammi in lei thukpi a tou a, suangpi tung a suangphum lem mi bang ahi; huan tui ahong khan in, tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, ahihling thei kei; hoihtak a lam ahih ziak in.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

paite: Himahleh thu za a mang lou suangphum louh a leitung maimah a inn lammi ahi; tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, achim pah a; huai inn siatna thupitak ahi,” achi hi.
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”
